The selected bidder furnished the Contract Performance Guarantee in favour of the Nodal Agency (CTUIL) for Rs. 52.00 crore on 3.2.2026 and acquired a hundred per cent equityholding in the applicant company on 3.2.2026 after execution of the Share Purchase Agreement.
